name: deepseekharness-for-vscode
description: DeepSeek Harness inside VS Code: auto-starts (or adopts) the dsh web server, shows the sessions/workspaces sidebar column in the side bar and the chat (conversation + details) as an editor tab (Claude-style), with start/stop control, status bar, and open-in-browser.

dsh.home.markdownDescription: DSH_HOME data directory (profiles, sessions, settings, credentials). Empty = the system default (`~/.dsh` or `$DSH_HOME`). Reusing your existing home makes the embedded server see your credentials and settings.

dsh.cliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the dsh CLI to run: either `…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js` or a `dsh` command name on PATH. Empty = auto resolution (bundled install, PATH lookup, then auto-install).

dsh.autoStart.markdownDescription: Start (or adopt) the dsh server automatically when VS Code starts and when the chat UI is opened.

dsh.preferNewer.markdownDescription: When several dsh installs are available (bundled / PATH / global npm), use the **newest** one. Off = always prefer the bundled version. 官方发布新版后，用 `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` 安装新版，扩展会自动使用它，无需重新打包扩展。

dsh.autoUpdate.markdownDescription: 每次启动时查询 npm registry，若官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 有比当前更新的版本，自动安装到扩展存储并优先使用（需要本机有 npm/npx；离线或失败时自动回退到现有版本）。关掉后只使用内置版本。

dsh.autoRestart.markdownDescription: Restart the server once after an unexpected exit while the panel is open.

dsh.autoInstall.markdownDescription: If no dsh installation is found, run `npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh` into the extension storage directory automatically. Requires npm on PATH.

dsh.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra CLI arguments forwarded to `dsh web` (e.g. `--trusted-host`).

dsh.workspaceRoot.markdownDescription: Working directory for the dsh process (the dsh workspace defaults to it). Empty = the current VS Code project (first workspace folder), or the user home when no folder is open.

dsh.followVscodeTheme.markdownDescription: 让内嵌的 dsh UI 主题跟随 VS Code 编辑器主题（通过 dsh 的 ui-theme.preference 设置自动切换深色/浅色），而不是跟随系统。

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run patch-frontend
scripts.smoke: npm run compile && npm run patch-frontend && node out/smoke.js
